records.context: This is a later London homecoming/rescue follow-up, with original event73 dependency158, not a guarantee that storage-neighbor72 has just run. Christina is glad to breathe home air; Lil encourages rest, Christina walks the harbor she has liked since childhood, and Lil party goes ahead to the inn. Mivor encounters her, interprets her arrival as a miracle of love and cries; she asks him not to cry in public, clarifies she is only visiting London and will sail again, explicitly denies returning for him or considering marrying him, and then explains she is not thinking of marriage at all yet. Preserve that refusal and his apparent acceptance; no reward or rescue later buys romantic consent. A mother167 cries that her little boy fell into the sea. Christina offers to rescue him and comforts him with elder-sister language; this is reassuring address, not proof of actual siblings. The three FE boy speeches carry source-visible Boy labels, unlike the unlabeled previous wedding FE panels. Preserve them as Boy: in English, complete cries and fear, rather than adding a unique name or treating actor254 as the boy. The frightened child clings around Christina neck, she struggles to breathe and fears they will both drown. Mivor sees no other rescuer, panics about the water, and the two greater-than/less-than internal comparisons weigh fear of the sea against Christina. Localize the comic emotional reversal clearly: fear initially wins, then concern/love for Christina wins. Repeated names and theatrical self-launch are part of his voice; remove Japanese vertical staging but no action or fear. He jumps in despite his previous inability to swim; later he himself is astonished he managed to swim. Do not silently turn the prior inability into skilled swimming or claim permanent mastery/cure of his fear. Christina coughs awake, asks about the child, and Mivor reports the child safe and mother thanks. She asks where her rescuer is; he hesitantly admits it was him, says the need to save her overwhelmed his thoughts, and cannot believe he swam. She remains surprised, leaves for the inn unaided and he takes his leave. The boy162 and mother encounter her, thank her and ask about the man; both familiar elder-sister/brother addresses are nonkinship. The mother confirms he jumped in shrieking and infers that he must love Christina deeply: keep this as her inference, not established mutual love. She offers an unnamed thank-you gift; do not invent its item identity, money amount or receipt outside this scripted exchange. Christina later recounts it to Lil, who is amazed at the water-fearing Mivor rescue. Mivor arrives; Christina explicitly thanks him and hesitantly says he looked cool/brave/impressive. He is ecstatic, but she says he is misunderstanding. He does not care because he is happy. She asks to set sail to escape his noise; he calls that he will wait forever. Lil thinks they make a good pair, Camille agrees, and Fernando privately thinks Lil andCamille also do. These are onlooker views and comic subtext, not a new engagement acceptance, actual wedding, guaranteed couple or earned gameplay event. records.comparison_basis: Current original runtime macro template;NFKC presentation forms andcollapsedlegacywhitespace. Raw/current/effective provenance stays separate.
records.context: Complete clean exchange read before older-English comparison. Fernando wins with a bluff, teaches Camille about luck and observation, then reluctantly admits Lil recruited him by winning at Old Maid. Fernando raises from10 to15 to30 chips. His opponent folds and then realizes Fernando had no hand. Fernando says luck made the opponent misread his bluff as bait to raise. Camille praises him; Fernando orders a drink for him from the barkeep. Discussion of looking closely becomes observation/insight, forming a winning habit and building early wins so a late bluff is convincing. Camille then asks why Fernando joined FI's ship. Fernando chokes and evades; Camille deduces that he lost a wager to Lil. Fernando admits his promise to join if she beat him, explains that she knew neither poker, baccarat nor blackjack, only Old Maid, and protests the absurdity of a grown man playing it seriously. Camille's final bad-luck line echoes the lesson ironically. Source storage order includes alternative paths,not one combined conversation. Exact current actor/item/stat/UI2000 bindings are attached;no selected-scene or earned-progress claim.

records.source_meaning: Al reminds his employer that he was hired as a bodyguard,not to carry luggage or run errands. Keep his gruff insistence on the work he was paid to do;no invented military or noble rank.
records.fresh_source_gloss: Al reminds his employer that he was hired as a bodyguard,not to carry luggage or run errands. Keep his gruff insistence on the work he was paid to do;no invented military or noble rank.
records.whole_exchange_context: Lil witnesses Al's argument with the Guildmaster,who pays his wages. Al insists he was hired as a bodyguard,not a porter or errand runner,andtakes his dangerous work seriously. The Guildmaster belittles his fighting-only skill andfires him;the Port Worker comments on Al's arrogance butadmits his exceptional strength will be hard to replace. Neither that speaker's Port Worker catalogue label nor his obedience licenses inventing a military rank or kinship. Lil and Camille admire Al's physique;an optional Emilio interruption makes a muscle/flab joke. Camille teases Lil's limited cool/handsome vocabulary,she decides to recruit Al anyway,andtheir familiar banter shows her playfully ignoring objections. Do not turn Camille's exasperation into an invented romantic relationship. Lil bluntly asks Al if he is strong,invites him to fight people who obstruct her,andanswers his refusal to babysit children bydeclaring she is not a child andtreating the agreement as settled. Camille's parenthesized internal objections andoptional Fernando's baffled aside preserve the comedy. Al's silence turns into laughter,thenfigurative admission of complete defeat andwillingness to join because she will provide plenty of fights. He introduces himself as Al Ferid Shin. Lil introduces herself with FI/FA andsays she is an admiral,qualified byher breezy ichio;Al's teasing Admiral address is therefore source-supported. His prediction that this will be absurd/amusing is laughter,not an actual preceding battle,threat of betrayal or a new romance. Camille remains puzzled andLil finds Al strange. Preserve the emotional progression anddistinct gruff,imperious,playful andwry voices. The Guildmaster belittles his fighting-only skill andfires him;the Port Worker comments on Al's arrogance butadmits his exceptional strength will be hard to replace. Neither that speaker's Port Worker catalogue label nor his obedience licenses inventing a military rank or kinship. Lil and Camille admire Al's physique;an optional Emilio interruption makes a muscle/flab joke. Camille teases Lil's limited cool/handsome vocabulary,she decides to recruit Al anyway,andtheir familiar banter shows her playfully ignoring objections. Do not turn Camille's exasperation into an invented romantic relationship. Lil bluntly asks Al if he is strong,invites him to fight people who obstruct her,andanswers his refusal to babysit children bydeclaring she is not a child andtreating the agreement as settled. Camille's parenthesized internal objections andoptional Fernando's baffled aside preserve the comedy. Al's silence turns into laughter,thenfigurative admission of complete defeat andwillingness to join because she will provide plenty of fights. He introduces himself as Al Ferid Shin. Lil introduces herself with FI/FA andsays she is an admiral,qualified byher breezy ichio;Al's teasing Admiral address is therefore source-supported. His prediction that this will be absurd/amusing is laughter,not an actual preceding battle,threat of betrayal or a new romance. Camille remains puzzled andLil finds Al strange. Preserve the emotional progression anddistinct gruff,imperious,playful andwry voices. records.source_meaning: Angelo calls out to someone as a low-ranking underling. Preserve the patronizing insult without assigning Camille a canonical crew rank or duty.
records.fresh_source_gloss: Angelo calls out to someone as a low-ranking underling. Preserve the patronizing insult without assigning Camille a canonical crew rank or duty.
records.whole_exchange_context: Angelo rudely calls Camille an underling and dismisses the value of an introduction through him. This is Angelo's belittling address,not proof of Camille's actual shipboard rank. Lil defends Camille bycalling Angelo okama,a dated derogatory gendered label for an effeminate/gay man. Angelo angrily denies it andcalls her a brat. Preserve the insult/denial exchange as their speech,not a narrator assertion about Angelo's sexuality or gender identity,anddo not invent women's clothing or a drag performance. Both characters are rude;Camille lateracknowledges that Lil was rude too. The insult should remain recognizable and the offended response should follow naturally without adding unrelated abuse. Optional Fernando comments on Lil's childish conduct. Camille defuses the argument,introduces himself andLil with FI/FA,andidentifies her as admiral. Angelo apologizes after learning her role. Lil objects to Camille apologizing for her;Angelo agrees with her andadmits he teases cute boys/guys. Keep that attraction/teasing cue without inventing a romance or fixed identity label. Camille awkwardly accepts the apology,thenstops Angelo leaving andoffers him a place as a navigator/crew companion. Lil andoptional Fernando object because Camille was insulted;Camille sees good in Angelo andvalues varied travel companions. Fernando admits Camille's generosity is a virtue butcannot read Angelo;Lil relents in exasperation. Camille welcomes Angelo before even asking his name;Angelo notices Camille has effectively persuaded Lil,apologizes again andintroduces himself as Angelo Puccini. Camille leads him toward the ship whileLil protests being left behind. Angelo corrects his familiar little-lady address to Admiral;Lil sweetly threatens to make him work hard. No invented kinship or earned recruitment outcome is claimed by prose. The same full block continues intoAngelo's Mediterranean-versus-Africa trade advice,withoptional Julio commentary. Existing developed routes look attractive,butmajor powers have already developed anddominate the Mediterranean,raising contract/investment costs andlimiting opportunities. Angelo recommends Africa as having development potential andunusual goods for Europe trade;the expected profits remain his argument,not a verified universal rule or a promise of a specific amount. He modestly attributes it to sailors' talk;Julio endorses the market-share logic andexplains thatmore cargo capacity doesnot ensure large transactions when European shares are difficult to acquire. Lil excitedly decides to head for Africa andmake money this time. Retain this progression from insult to apology,unexpected welcome,playful authority andpractical travel motivation. Source macro counts are {'FI': 5, 'FA': 1, 'FO': 0};branch/resource/pause/recruitment effects are separate native obligations.

records.context: Angelo rudely calls Camille an underling and dismisses the value of an introduction through him. This is Angelo's belittling address,not proof of Camille's actual shipboard rank. Lil defends Camille bycalling Angelo okama,a dated derogatory gendered label for an effeminate/gay man. Angelo angrily denies it andcalls her a brat. Preserve the insult/denial exchange as their speech,not a narrator assertion about Angelo's sexuality or gender identity,anddo not invent women's clothing or a drag performance. Both characters are rude;Camille lateracknowledges that Lil was rude too. The insult should remain recognizable and the offended response should follow naturally without adding unrelated abuse. Optional Fernando comments on Lil's childish conduct. Camille defuses the argument,introduces himself andLil with FI/FA,andidentifies her as admiral. Angelo apologizes after learning her role. Lil objects to Camille apologizing for her;Angelo agrees with her andadmits he teases cute boys/guys. Keep that attraction/teasing cue without inventing a romance or fixed identity label. Camille awkwardly accepts the apology,thenstops Angelo leaving andoffers him a place as a navigator/crew companion. Lil andoptional Fernando object because Camille was insulted;Camille sees good in Angelo andvalues varied travel companions. Fernando admits Camille's generosity is a virtue butcannot read Angelo;Lil relents in exasperation. Camille welcomes Angelo before even asking his name;Angelo notices Camille has effectively persuaded Lil,apologizes again andintroduces himself as Angelo Puccini. Camille leads him toward the ship whileLil protests being left behind. Angelo corrects his familiar little-lady address to Admiral;Lil sweetly threatens to make him work hard. No invented kinship or earned recruitment outcome is claimed by prose. The same full block continues intoAngelo's Mediterranean-versus-Africa trade advice,withoptional Julio commentary. Existing developed routes look attractive,butmajor powers have already developed anddominate the Mediterranean,raising contract/investment costs andlimiting opportunities. Angelo recommends Africa as having development potential andunusual goods for Europe trade;the expected profits remain his argument,not a verified universal rule or a promise of a specific amount. He modestly attributes it to sailors' talk;Julio endorses the market-share logic andexplains thatmore cargo capacity doesnot ensure large transactions when European shares are difficult to acquire. Lil excitedly decides to head for Africa andmake money this time. Retain this progression from insult to apology,unexpected welcome,playful authority andpractical travel motivation. Source macro counts are {'FI': 5, 'FA': 1, 'FO': 0};branch/resource/pause/recruitment effects are separate native obligations.

records.context: Angelo rudely calls Camille an underling and dismisses the value of an introduction through him. This is Angelo's belittling address,not proof of Camille's actual shipboard rank. Lil defends Camille bycalling Angelo okama,a dated derogatory gendered label for an effeminate/gay man. Angelo angrily denies it andcalls her a brat. Preserve the insult/denial exchange as their speech,not a narrator assertion about Angelo's sexuality or gender identity,anddo not invent women's clothing or a drag performance. Both characters are rude;Camille lateracknowledges that Lil was rude too. The insult should remain recognizable and the offended response should follow naturally without adding unrelated abuse. Optional Fernando comments on Lil's childish conduct. Camille defuses the argument,introduces himself andLil with FI/FA,andidentifies her as admiral. Angelo apologizes after learning her role. Lil objects to Camille apologizing for her;Angelo agrees with her andadmits he teases cute boys/guys. Keep that attraction/teasing cue without inventing a romance or fixed identity label. Camille awkwardly accepts the apology,thenstops Angelo leaving andoffers him a place as a navigator/crew companion. Lil andoptional Fernando object because Camille was insulted;Camille sees good in Angelo andvalues varied travel companions. Fernando admits Camille's generosity is a virtue butcannot read Angelo;Lil relents in exasperation. Camille welcomes Angelo before even asking his name;Angelo notices Camille has effectively persuaded Lil,apologizes again andintroduces himself as Angelo Puccini. Camille leads him toward the ship whileLil protests being left behind. Angelo corrects his familiar little-lady address to Admiral;Lil sweetly threatens to make him work hard. No invented kinship or earned recruitment outcome is claimed by prose. The same full block continues intoAngelo's Mediterranean-versus-Africa trade advice,withoptional Julio commentary. Existing developed routes look attractive,butmajor powers have already developed anddominate the Mediterranean,raising contract/investment costs andlimiting opportunities. Angelo recommends Africa as having development potential andunusual goods for Europe trade;the expected profits remain his argument,not a verified universal rule or a promise of a specific amount. He modestly attributes it to sailors' talk;Julio endorses the market-share logic andexplains thatmore cargo capacity doesnot ensure large transactions when European shares are difficult to acquire. Lil excitedly decides to head for Africa andmake money this time. Retain this progression from insult to apology,unexpected welcome,playful authority andpractical travel motivation. Ian works serving drinks for the Barkeep. A couple comments onhis beauty andquestions whether he is a man;Ian's inner reaction shows thatbeing treated as a spectacle is recurring andunwelcome. The woman is excited byhis serving her andher male companion resents it. A Patron calls Ian a young woman,requests thathe pour a drink,comments onhis appearance/fair skin andquestions his being male. Ian stays silent untilunwanted touching prompts Don't touch me. The Patron cries out inharmed surprise,swears andsarcastically complains abouttreatment ofa customer;Ian realizes he haslost restraint andapologizes formally. Do notinvent a specific wound,grabbing technique,rape threat orpunishment. The later Barkeep explicitly objects tohis use ofa sword,so do noterase the blade reference orassert thatonly a harmless verbal exchange occurred. Lil orders a drink;optional Fernando orders more andEmilio asks forfood. The Barkeep draws Ian aside,says the job doesnot suit him,objects tothe trouble andsword use,andfires him. Ian accepts quietly. Oyaji-san is a familiar address tothis older employer,not evidence ofa father/son relationship.
Lil is intrigued bythe beautiful stranger's melancholy eyes andpossible past. Camille gives curt answers;she teases thathe is jealous andhe stammers a denial. This isexplicit dialogue teasing,not a narrator confirmation ofjealousy or an invented romance. She goes totalk toIan. His inner thoughts reveal unemployment,no money andlonging toreturn tosea afterseeing ships offshore. The earlier Patron finds him alone,calls out again andsummons a group forrevenge afterthe humiliation. Ian judges he cannot defeat themall andtargets onlythe man whoappears tolead them. The woman is excited byhis serving her andher male companion resents it. A Patron calls Ian a young woman,requests thathe pour a drink,comments onhis appearance/fair skin andquestions his being male. Ian stays silent untilunwanted touching prompts Don't touch me. The Patron cries out inharmed surprise,swears andsarcastically complains abouttreatment ofa customer;Ian realizes he haslost restraint andapologizes formally. Do notinvent a specific wound,grabbing technique,rape threat orpunishment. The later Barkeep explicitly objects tohis use ofa sword,so do noterase the blade reference orassert thatonly a harmless verbal exchange occurred. Lil orders a drink;optional Fernando orders more andEmilio asks forfood. The Barkeep draws Ian aside,says the job doesnot suit him,objects tothe trouble andsword use,andfires him. Ian accepts quietly. Oyaji-san is a familiar address tothis older employer,not evidence ofa father/son relationship.
Lil is intrigued bythe beautiful stranger's melancholy eyes andpossible past. Camille gives curt answers;she teases thathe is jealous andhe stammers a denial. This isexplicit dialogue teasing,not a narrator confirmation ofjealousy or an invented romance. She goes totalk toIan. His inner thoughts reveal unemployment,no money andlonging toreturn tosea afterseeing ships offshore. The earlier Patron finds him alone,calls out again andsummons a group forrevenge afterthe humiliation. Ian judges he cannot defeat themall andtargets onlythe man whoappears tolead them. The Patron scolds his followers;the Retainer leers abouthis pretty face andfinds his fighting enticing. Preserve the sexualized harassment as the aggressor's speech,not mutual attraction or narrator approval. Ian tires andcannot getclose tothe leader alone;the Patron orders his men tofinish him. Lil intervenes,saying she cannot leave such a handsome man introuble. The Patron retreats,claiming he onlyfights battles he canwin andthreatening thathe willremember this. No invented faction,noble/military rank orproof ofactual in-game combat victory.
Afterthe rescue,Lil enthusiastically compliments Ian's looks. Camille makes a source-explicit joke thatFI looks unmistakably like a man nexttoIan;optional Fernando laughs andagrees,andLil protests. Keep it as their rude teasing,not a narrator statement aboutanyone's gender identity. Ian privately dismisses theimportance ofappearance;Lil isoffended because she meant a compliment. He clarifies he was talking tohimself,apologizes andthanks themall forsaving his life. Lil turns thefavor intoa request andIan agrees ifhe canhelp. She explains they aresailors andoffers him work forhis skill as a bodyguard/travel companion. He pauses;Camille politely asks iftheoffer isunacceptable. Ian says he welcomes it. Lil jokingly assumes itis because she isattractive;Camille's aside questions her audacity givenIan's beauty. Ian courteously acknowledges her appeal,thenreveals thathe is an unemployed navigator whose previous ship sank. Preserve the ship he wasaboard,not invented ownership/captaincy. The chance togo tosea again genuinelyhelps him. Lil realizes thearrangement benefits bothsides andasks his name;he introduces himself as Ian Dukov. The spoken acceptance remains distinct froman earned recruitment effect. records.whole_exchange_context:
Ian works serving drinks for the Barkeep. A couple comments onhis beauty andquestions whether he is a man;Ian's inner reaction shows thatbeing treated as a spectacle is recurring andunwelcome. The woman is excited byhis serving her andher male companion resents it. A Patron calls Ian a young woman,requests thathe pour a drink,comments onhis appearance/fair skin andquestions his being male. Ian stays silent untilunwanted touching prompts Don't touch me. The Patron cries out inharmed surprise,swears andsarcastically complains abouttreatment ofa customer;Ian realizes he haslost restraint andapologizes formally. Do notinvent a specific wound,grabbing technique,rape threat orpunishment. The later Barkeep explicitly objects tohis use ofa sword,so do noterase the blade reference orassert thatonly a harmless verbal exchange occurred. Lil orders a drink;optional Fernando orders more andEmilio asks forfood. The Barkeep draws Ian aside,says the job doesnot suit him,objects tothe trouble andsword use,andfires him. Ian accepts quietly. Oyaji-san is a familiar address tothis older employer,not evidence ofa father/son relationship.
Lil is intrigued bythe beautiful stranger's melancholy eyes andpossible past. Camille gives curt answers;she teases thathe is jealous andhe stammers a denial. This isexplicit dialogue teasing,not a narrator confirmation ofjealousy or an invented romance. She goes totalk toIan. His inner thoughts reveal unemployment,no money andlonging toreturn tosea afterseeing ships offshore. The earlier Patron finds him alone,calls out again andsummons a group forrevenge afterthe humiliation. Ian judges he cannot defeat themall andtargets onlythe man whoappears tolead them. The Patron scolds his followers;the Retainer leers abouthis pretty face andfinds his fighting enticing. Preserve the sexualized harassment as the aggressor's speech,not mutual attraction or narrator approval. Ian tires andcannot getclose tothe leader alone;the Patron orders his men tofinish him. Lil intervenes,saying she cannot leave such a handsome man introuble. The Patron retreats,claiming he onlyfights battles he canwin andthreatening thathe willremember this. No invented faction,noble/military rank orproof ofactual in-game combat victory.
Afterthe rescue,Lil enthusiastically compliments Ian's looks. Camille makes a source-explicit joke thatFI looks unmistakably like a man nexttoIan;optional Fernando laughs andagrees,andLil protests. Keep it as their rude teasing,not a narrator statement aboutanyone's gender identity. Ian privately dismisses theimportance ofappearance;Lil isoffended because she meant a compliment. He clarifies he was talking tohimself,apologizes andthanks themall forsaving his life. Lil turns thefavor intoa request andIan agrees ifhe canhelp. She explains they aresailors andoffers him work forhis skill as a bodyguard/travel companion. He pauses;Camille politely asks iftheoffer isunacceptable. Ian says he welcomes it. Lil jokingly assumes itis because she isattractive;Camille's aside questions her audacity givenIan's beauty. Ian courteously acknowledges her appeal,thenreveals thathe is an unemployed navigator whose previous ship sank. Preserve the ship he wasaboard,not invented ownership/captaincy. The chance togo tosea again genuinelyhelps him. Lil realizes thearrangement benefits bothsides andasks his name;he introduces himself as Ian Dukov. The spoken acceptance remains distinct froman earned recruitment effect. Ian works serving drinks for the Barkeep. A couple comments onhis beauty andquestions whether he is a man;Ian's inner reaction shows thatbeing treated as a spectacle is recurring andunwelcome. The woman is excited byhis serving her andher male companion resents it. A Patron calls Ian a young woman,requests thathe pour a drink,comments onhis appearance/fair skin andquestions his being male. Ian stays silent untilunwanted touching prompts Don't touch me. The Patron cries out inharmed surprise,swears andsarcastically complains abouttreatment ofa customer;Ian realizes he haslost restraint andapologizes formally. Do notinvent a specific wound,grabbing technique,rape threat orpunishment. The later Barkeep explicitly objects tohis use ofa sword,so do noterase the blade reference orassert thatonly a harmless verbal exchange occurred. Lil orders a drink;optional Fernando orders more andEmilio asks forfood. The Barkeep draws Ian aside,says the job doesnot suit him,objects tothe trouble andsword use,andfires him. Ian accepts quietly. Oyaji-san is a familiar address tothis older employer,not evidence ofa father/son relationship.
Lil is intrigued bythe beautiful stranger's melancholy eyes andpossible past. Camille gives curt answers;she teases thathe is jealous andhe stammers a denial. This isexplicit dialogue teasing,not a narrator confirmation ofjealousy or an invented romance. She goes totalk toIan. His inner thoughts reveal unemployment,no money andlonging toreturn tosea afterseeing ships offshore. The earlier Patron finds him alone,calls out again andsummons a group forrevenge afterthe humiliation. Ian judges he cannot defeat themall andtargets onlythe man whoappears tolead them. The Patron scolds his followers;the Retainer leers abouthis pretty face andfinds his fighting enticing. Preserve the sexualized harassment as the aggressor's speech,not mutual attraction or narrator approval. Ian tires andcannot getclose tothe leader alone;the Patron orders his men tofinish him. Lil intervenes,saying she cannot leave such a handsome man introuble. The Patron retreats,claiming he onlyfights battles he canwin andthreatening thathe willremember this. No invented faction,noble/military rank orproof ofactual in-game combat victory.
Afterthe rescue,Lil enthusiastically compliments Ian's looks. Camille makes a source-explicit joke thatFI looks unmistakably like a man nexttoIan;optional Fernando laughs andagrees,andLil protests. Keep it as their rude teasing,not a narrator statement aboutanyone's gender identity. Ian privately dismisses theimportance ofappearance;Lil isoffended because she meant a compliment. He clarifies he was talking tohimself,apologizes andthanks themall forsaving his life. Lil turns thefavor intoa request andIan agrees ifhe canhelp. She explains they aresailors andoffers him work forhis skill as a bodyguard/travel companion. He pauses;Camille politely asks iftheoffer isunacceptable. Ian says he welcomes it. Lil jokingly assumes itis because she isattractive;Camille's aside questions her audacity givenIan's beauty. Ian courteously acknowledges her appeal,thenreveals thathe is an unemployed navigator whose previous ship sank. Preserve the ship he wasaboard,not invented ownership/captaincy. The chance togo tosea again genuinelyhelps him. Lil realizes thearrangement benefits bothsides andasks his name;he introduces himself as Ian Dukov. records.whole_exchange_context:
Carlo orders his usual quantity ofcinnamon fromthe Trader addressed inJapanese asAdil. They know one another:Carlo challenges theprice,knows his purchasing cost,cites thisyear's yield andlocal demand,andthreatens tobuy elsewhere. The Trader yields. Carlo thennotices his fever/pallor;the Trader first mistakes this foranother bargaining complaint,thenfeels chills. Carlo postpones his ownpurchase andurges him toclose/rest;the Trader apologizes tothe other waiting customers. Lil asks howCarlo knew he wasill. Carlo cites his poorcolor. Optional Fernando boasts thatCarlo's insight isasgood ashis. Lil's uncertain inner reply isoutside thatoptional branch,so retain its ability torefer tothe pallor explanation without Fernando present. Carlo says he issensitive topeople's health andoffers tomake up thedelay bymeeting Lil atthe trading post tomorrow morning. Lil eagerly treats itasrepaying afavor,not a monetary debt.
The nextday,the woman whose native catalogue role isInnkeeper thanks Carlo andsays Adil isathome resting asa precaution. She complains thathe doesnot listen toher;do notinvent an explicit marriage label forthis woman ortranslate familiar address asCarlo's wife. Carlo's later ownwife/daughter are explicit andmust remain distinct. The woman calls Carlo alifesaver andoffers thanks;this isher grateful characterization,not independent proof ofa fatal illness ormedical cure. Carlo redirects thethanks tothe travelers whowaited overnight. She apologizes fortheir delay andoffers an unnamed modest gift. Preserve theoffer without inventing money,itemidentity or an earned inventory effect. Carlo thanks her asan older woman/proprietress andoffers thetravelers priority because they areinahurry. Adil thenappears,claiming he isfit andcannot stay inbed ona fine dayforbusiness. The woman scolds him;Carlo isrelieved butstillurges moderation andsays he willreturn anotherday. He entrusts their trade tothe shopkeeper andadvises thetravelers totreasure family andhealth.
Lil pauses,thenasks Carlo togo tosea withher. Her familiar oji-san address establishes no uncle relationship. She feels they wouldgetalong andhasanintuition. Carlo protests thathe isamerchant,not asailor;Lil isdelighted thathe isaprofessional,exempts himfromoperating theship andpoints out thatshe isamerchant too. She asks whether he hasareason tostay,withMalacca notbeing hishometown asarhetorical question,not evidence ofan invented birthplace oraccent. Carlo reveals his family died ayearago. His nexttwo sourceFE panels arehis first-person recollection,not omniscient narration or a newunnamed speaker. Firsthis daughter caught theillness goingaround;he wasabsorbed inwork anddidnot adequately care forher. Treatment wasdelayed,his wife caught ittoo,andhelost both. Preserve his personal regret without naming a pathogen,age,doctor,medical specialty orjudgment beyond hissource words. Thework hebought attheneglect ofhis family felt empty. Since thenotherpeople's health concerns himmore thanwork. Lil understands whyhe noticed Adil's illness andasks whether heconsidered returning home. Carlo namesVenice;itcontains toomany happy memories forhimtolivethere alone. Do noterase thelove inthose memories orconvert his grief intohatred ofVenice.
Lil renews theinvitation tothegroup andexplicitly promises thatthey willbecome his family. This source-supported chosen-family offer doesnot invent biological parenthood,adoption paperwork,romance or a shipdoctor position. Optional Emilio encourages shared meals;gohan meansfood/meals,not necessarily rice. Camille enthusiastically praises FI's compassionate remark. Lil deflects withher habitual claim thatshe always saysgood things,andseeks Carlo's agreement. Carlo thanks themandaccepts;Lil celebrates. Camille says FI hasrisen somewhat inhis estimation. Keep theheartfelt gratitude andhis unusual respect alongside Lil's comic self-regard. Carlo gives his fullname;the bound native approved catalogue spelling isCarlo Sinat. They know one another:Carlo challenges theprice,knows his purchasing cost,cites thisyear's yield andlocal demand,andthreatens tobuy elsewhere. The Trader yields. Carlo thennotices his fever/pallor;the Trader first mistakes this foranother bargaining complaint,thenfeels chills. Carlo postpones his ownpurchase andurges him toclose/rest;the Trader apologizes tothe other waiting customers. Lil asks howCarlo knew he wasill. Carlo cites his poorcolor. Optional Fernando boasts thatCarlo's insight isasgood ashis. Lil's uncertain inner reply isoutside thatoptional branch,so retain its ability torefer tothe pallor explanation without Fernando present. Carlo says he issensitive topeople's health andoffers tomake up thedelay bymeeting Lil atthe trading post tomorrow morning. Lil eagerly treats itasrepaying afavor,not a monetary debt.
The nextday,the woman whose native catalogue role isInnkeeper thanks Carlo andsays Adil isathome resting asa precaution. She complains thathe doesnot listen toher;do notinvent an explicit marriage label forthis woman ortranslate familiar address asCarlo's wife. Carlo's later ownwife/daughter are explicit andmust remain distinct. The woman calls Carlo alifesaver andoffers thanks;this isher grateful characterization,not independent proof ofa fatal illness ormedical cure. Carlo redirects thethanks tothe travelers whowaited overnight. She apologizes fortheir delay andoffers an unnamed modest gift. Preserve theoffer without inventing money,itemidentity or an earned inventory effect. Carlo thanks her asan older woman/proprietress andoffers thetravelers priority because they areinahurry. Adil thenappears,claiming he isfit andcannot stay inbed ona fine dayforbusiness. The woman scolds him;Carlo isrelieved butstillurges moderation andsays he willreturn anotherday. He entrusts their trade tothe shopkeeper andadvises thetravelers totreasure family andhealth.
Lil pauses,thenasks Carlo togo tosea withher. Her familiar oji-san address establishes no uncle relationship. She feels they wouldgetalong andhasanintuition. Carlo protests thathe isamerchant,not asailor;Lil isdelighted thathe isaprofessional,exempts himfromoperating theship andpoints out thatshe isamerchant too. She asks whether he hasareason tostay,withMalacca notbeing hishometown asarhetorical question,not evidence ofan invented birthplace oraccent. Carlo reveals his family died ayearago. His nexttwo sourceFE panels arehis first-person recollection,not omniscient narration or a newunnamed speaker. Firsthis daughter caught theillness goingaround;he wasabsorbed inwork anddidnot adequately care forher. Treatment wasdelayed,his wife caught ittoo,andhelost both. Adil thenappears,claiming he isfit andcannot stay inbed ona fine dayforbusiness. The woman scolds him;Carlo isrelieved butstillurges moderation andsays he willreturn anotherday. He entrusts their trade tothe shopkeeper andadvises thetravelers totreasure family andhealth.

records.whole_exchange_context:
The group is relaxing over drinks and food. Lil exhales and remarks on how much she has drunk. Optional Camille cautions FI against drinking too much. Optional Emilio declares he can still eat more; Camille's optional rebuke is nested within Emilio's branch, so it addresses him rather than an absent speaker. Cristina says she too has drunk quite a bit, then notices something. Music begins under source presentation controls. Lil calls the music passionate and likes it; optional Camille agrees. Cristina recognizes the song and excuses herself. Lil wonders what Cristina is doing. A source picture transition and original two-byte pause precede two FE panels labelled Customer1 and Customer2 in the Japanese text. They are admiring anonymous patrons, not new static portrait actors or relatives. One exclaims that the young woman is amazing; the other admires both her beauty and dancing. Lil admires Cristina as cool/impressive; optional Camille calls her beautiful. Another FE panel combines both patron labels and their exaggerated repeated Bravo cheers. The fourth FE panel is applause onomatopoeia, not a new speaker or a spoken literal word. Source picture/pause/music changes remain distinct from translated dialogue.
Cristina returns, saying she could not help dancing because she likes this song. Lil repeats her admiration; optional Camille praises her swordplay as graceful but her dancing as still more graceful. Cristina laughs softly and thanks them. Do not invent a professional dancing job, training history, hometown, stage venue, patrons' identities, kinship, romantic relationship or source location. The feminine pronouns follow the Japanese woman reference and Cristina's dialogue identity; admiration does not itself establish romance. Lil is astonished by a large-eared animal; Camille identifies an elephant and she marvels. Optional Emilio wonders whether it would taste good roasted whole; optional Fernando's rebuke is nested inside Emilio's branch, so it targets the food obsession of an actually present Emilio. A boyish male vendor, source selector22 and current first-name catalogue Samwell, hawks his wares, notices the unusual travelers and abruptly asks to travel with them. He is tired of seeing elephants and wants to visit other countries. This gives no specific source port, birthplace, nationality or professional rank. Lil objects to the presumptuous request. Camille teases FI about her anger and wrinkles, provoking her, then apologizes to the newcomer while joking that getting angry is her hobby. Samwell smugly agrees, says he ignores what a fat/chubby person says and boasts of his generosity/broad-mindedness. He is insulting Lil; the text does not objectively establish her size, an affectionate nickname, mutual attraction or a romance. Lil protests and threatens to knock him flying. Samwell continues the anger-hobby joke, condescendingly says he does not dislike a round face, and she is left sputtering. Camille asks him to stop for Camille's own sake, then redirects him to his skills.
Samwell proudly claims cooking as his specialty. Optional Emilio is electrified. Lil distrusts the boast and says people who insult a lady are no good; Samwell argues that he merely called her fat and did not insult her. Her reply explicitly calls that an insult and demands Camille leave with her. Optional Emilio invites Samwell to join without permission; Lil's objection and Emilio's hesitant excuse are inside that same branch. Camille's following independent wait/show-us-your-skill request must also work if Emilio is absent. Samwell readily cooks something unspecified. Camille begins eating with a conventional meal-opening expression, chews and is startled by how good it is. He starts comparing it favorably to FI's cooking and catches himself. Lil drawls his name menacingly and asks what he said. Optional Emilio spells out his delight in the food. Camille denies or evades the comparison and invites FI to taste it too. Lil threatens consequences if it is bad, then reluctantly admits it is delicious. Preserve her embarrassed concession rather than inventing poisoning, a named recipe or a particular cuisine.
Camille treats their decision as settled, introduces himself as Camille and FI as their admiral, using the explicit source rank and runtime name. Do not invent a middle name in this spoken introduction. Lil grudgingly accepts on the condition/benefit of eating such cooking every day and says she will put up with him a little, then offers a greeting. Samwell repeats the fat/chubby insult in his own greeting. Lil reverses her restraint with an exaggerated I will kill you threat; Camille sighs that the future looks troublesome. Optional Emilio asks for seconds as the food-focused final punch line. These are character jokes, insults, threats and opinions, not narrator endorsements or evidence of an actual assault, death, earned roster change or a romantic relationship. Preserve source body-directed insults as provocations with their comic emotional progression; do not sanitize them into unrelated teasing or present their content as objective fact. Optional Emilio wonders whether it would taste good roasted whole; optional Fernando's rebuke is nested inside Emilio's branch, so it targets the food obsession of an actually present Emilio. A boyish male vendor, source selector22 and current first-name catalogue Samwell, hawks his wares, notices the unusual travelers and abruptly asks to travel with them. He is tired of seeing elephants and wants to visit other countries. This gives no specific source port, birthplace, nationality or professional rank. Lil objects to the presumptuous request. Camille teases FI about her anger and wrinkles, provoking her, then apologizes to the newcomer while joking that getting angry is her hobby. Samwell smugly agrees, says he ignores what a fat/chubby person says and boasts of his generosity/broad-mindedness. He is insulting Lil; the text does not objectively establish her size, an affectionate nickname, mutual attraction or a romance. Lil protests and threatens to knock him flying. Samwell continues the anger-hobby joke, condescendingly says he does not dislike a round face, and she is left sputtering. Camille asks him to stop for Camille's own sake, then redirects him to his skills.
Samwell proudly claims cooking as his specialty. Optional Emilio is electrified. Lil distrusts the boast and says people who insult a lady are no good; Samwell argues that he merely called her fat and did not insult her. Her reply explicitly calls that an insult and demands Camille leave with her. Optional Emilio invites Samwell to join without permission; Lil's objection and Emilio's hesitant excuse are inside that same branch. Camille's following independent wait/show-us-your-skill request must also work if Emilio is absent. Samwell readily cooks something unspecified. Camille begins eating with a conventional meal-opening expression, chews and is startled by how good it is. He starts comparing it favorably to FI's cooking and catches himself. Lil drawls his name menacingly and asks what he said. Optional Emilio spells out his delight in the food. Camille denies or evades the comparison and invites FI to taste it too. Lil threatens consequences if it is bad, then reluctantly admits it is delicious. Preserve her embarrassed concession rather than inventing poisoning, a named recipe or a particular cuisine.
Camille treats their decision as settled, introduces himself as Camille and FI as their admiral, using the explicit source rank and runtime name. Do not invent a middle name in this spoken introduction. Lil grudgingly accepts on the condition/benefit of eating such cooking every day and says she will put up with him a little, then offers a greeting. Samwell repeats the fat/chubby insult in his own greeting. Lil reverses her restraint with an exaggerated I will kill you threat; Camille sighs that the future looks troublesome. Optional Emilio asks for seconds as the food-focused final punch line. These are character jokes, insults, threats and opinions, not narrator endorsements or evidence of an actual assault, death, earned roster change or a romantic relationship. Preserve source body-directed insults as provocations with their comic emotional progression; do not sanitize them into unrelated teasing or present their content as objective fact. All optional branches, FI4, source controls, eligibility/effect ownership and native full-name display require their own proofs. The observed current catalogue full name is mixed-script Samwell ダ Khan; resolve its exact clean/current native/UI ownership and existing policy before any name-asset edit. Use no guessed full name in dialogue where the clean exchange supplies no spoken full introduction.

records.context:
Lil is astonished by a large-eared animal; Camille identifies an elephant and she marvels. Optional Emilio wonders whether it would taste good roasted whole; optional Fernando's rebuke is nested inside Emilio's branch, so it targets the food obsession of an actually present Emilio. A boyish male vendor, source selector22 and current first-name catalogue Samwell, hawks his wares, notices the unusual travelers and abruptly asks to travel with them. He is tired of seeing elephants and wants to visit other countries. This gives no specific source port, birthplace, nationality or professional rank. Lil objects to the presumptuous request. Camille teases FI about her anger and wrinkles, provoking her, then apologizes to the newcomer while joking that getting angry is her hobby. Samwell smugly agrees, says he ignores what a fat/chubby person says and boasts of his generosity/broad-mindedness. He is insulting Lil; the text does not objectively establish her size, an affectionate nickname, mutual attraction or a romance. Lil protests and threatens to knock him flying. Samwell continues the anger-hobby joke, condescendingly says he does not dislike a round face, and she is left sputtering. Camille asks him to stop for Camille's own sake, then redirects him to his skills.
Samwell proudly claims cooking as his specialty. Optional Emilio is electrified. Lil distrusts the boast and says people who insult a lady are no good; Samwell argues that he merely called her fat and did not insult her. Her reply explicitly calls that an insult and demands Camille leave with her. Optional Emilio invites Samwell to join without permission; Lil's objection and Emilio's hesitant excuse are inside that same branch. Camille's following independent wait/show-us-your-skill request must also work if Emilio is absent. Samwell readily cooks something unspecified. Camille begins eating with a conventional meal-opening expression, chews and is startled by how good it is. He starts comparing it favorably to FI's cooking and catches himself. Lil drawls his name menacingly and asks what he said. Optional Emilio spells out his delight in the food. Camille denies or evades the comparison and invites FI to taste it too. Lil threatens consequences if it is bad, then reluctantly admits it is delicious. Preserve her embarrassed concession rather than inventing poisoning, a named recipe or a particular cuisine.
Camille treats their decision as settled, introduces himself as Camille and FI as their admiral, using the explicit source rank and runtime name. Do not invent a middle name in this spoken introduction. Lil grudgingly accepts on the condition/benefit of eating such cooking every day and says she will put up with him a little, then offers a greeting. Samwell repeats the fat/chubby insult in his own greeting. Lil reverses her restraint with an exaggerated I will kill you threat; Camille sighs that the future looks troublesome. Optional Emilio asks for seconds as the food-focused final punch line. These are character jokes, insults, threats and opinions, not narrator endorsements or evidence of an actual assault, death, earned roster change or a romantic relationship. Preserve source body-directed insults as provocations with their comic emotional progression; do not sanitize them into unrelated teasing or present their content as objective fact. The observed current catalogue full name is mixed-script Samwell ダ Khan; resolve its exact clean/current native/UI ownership and existing policy before any name-asset edit. Use no guessed full name in dialogue where the clean exchange supplies no spoken full introduction.

records.context:
A source151 crewman urgently addresses the admiral and says the ship is missing. The original progressive UI calls him Sailor even though the full catalogue role is Retainer; reuse and bind that specific original name-consumer proof before authoring, without inventing a political or household position. Lil doubts the report and wonders whether he has mixed it up with the neighboring ship. Camille calls it a harsh joke so early in the morning. Optional Angelo grumbles about losing sleep and its effect on his skin; his source vanity makes a natural beauty-sleep joke appropriate, without asserting medical guidance or adding an unspoken romance/identity claim. The Sailor insists and asks them to come to the departure/port facility immediately. An original C283 command mediates the source transition. Lil sees that the ship really is gone.
An optional Emilio branch contains all four connected turns:Lil jokingly wonders whether Emilio ate it; he denies it and says he does not eat things that look unappetizing, insisting he is telling the truth; she says she was joking, then catches herself because this is not the time for jokes and demands an explanation; he falls silent. Do not make the surrounding core dialogue depend on this optional joke or invent an actual eaten ship. The Sailor anxiously asks what they should do. Optional Angelo invokes Mamma mia and says he is wide awake now. Camille asks what happened. The Port Worker calls to the admiral and reports what he saw early that morning:a lanky young man alone, tinkering with the ship, then sailing away. Keep the report attributed to the witness and preserve the single-man surprise. Do not invent the thief's name, crew membership, nationality, magic, motive or a recovered ship.
Optional Angelo asks why the Port Worker did not stop him. Camille is troubled and asks FI what they should do. The Port Worker says he never expected the man to sail away:because he was alone, he assumed he was inspecting or checking the ship. This explanatory line remains coherent without Angelo's optional challenge. Lil accepts that one would not expect him to set sail alone. Camille proposes gathering information in town and finding the ship thief. Optional Angelo invokes Mamma mia again and complains about their bad luck. Preserve the progression from disbelief and sleepy banter to confirmed loss, the food joke, witness report, explanation and practical search plan. Source explicit admiral addresses and one runtime FI remain intact. Mamma mia is a source-supported cultural expression; add no national biography. The exchange gives no specific port, exact time, duration, number of missing fleet ships, flagship designation, ownership document, recovered vessel or actual earned loss state. Preserve ship/boat reference consistently without inflating it into the whole fleet. A source151 crewman urgently addresses the admiral and says the ship is missing. The original progressive UI calls him Sailor even though the full catalogue role is Retainer; reuse and bind that specific original name-consumer proof before authoring, without inventing a political or household position. Lil doubts the report and wonders whether he has mixed it up with the neighboring ship. Camille calls it a harsh joke so early in the morning. Optional Angelo grumbles about losing sleep and its effect on his skin; his source vanity makes a natural beauty-sleep joke appropriate, without asserting medical guidance or adding an unspoken romance/identity claim. The Sailor insists and asks them to come to the departure/port facility immediately. An original C283 command mediates the source transition. Lil sees that the ship really is gone.

Do not make the surrounding core dialogue depend on this optional joke or invent an actual eaten ship. The Sailor anxiously asks what they should do. Optional Angelo invokes Mamma mia and says he is wide awake now. Camille asks what happened. The Port Worker calls to the admiral and reports what he saw early that morning:a lanky young man alone, tinkering with the ship, then sailing away. Keep the report attributed to the witness and preserve the single-man surprise. Do not invent the thief's name, crew membership, nationality, magic, motive or a recovered ship.

The original progressive UI calls him Sailor even though the full catalogue role is Retainer; reuse and bind that specific original name-consumer proof before authoring, without inventing a political or household position. Lil doubts the report and wonders whether he has mixed it up with the neighboring ship. Camille calls it a harsh joke so early in the morning. Optional Angelo grumbles about losing sleep and its effect on his skin; his source vanity makes a natural beauty-sleep joke appropriate, without asserting medical guidance or adding an unspoken romance/identity claim. The Sailor insists and asks them to come to the departure/port facility immediately. An original C283 command mediates the source transition. Lil sees that the ship really is gone.
An optional Emilio branch contains all four connected turns:Lil jokingly wonders whether Emilio ate it; he denies it and says he does not eat things that look unappetizing, insisting he is telling the truth; she says she was joking, then catches herself because this is not the time for jokes and demands an explanation; he falls silent. Do not make the surrounding core dialogue depend on this optional joke or invent an actual eaten ship. The Sailor anxiously asks what they should do. Optional Angelo invokes Mamma mia and says he is wide awake now. Camille asks what happened. The Port Worker calls to the admiral and reports what he saw early that morning:a lanky young man alone, tinkering with the ship, then sailing away. Keep the report attributed to the witness and preserve the single-man surprise. Do not invent the thief's name, crew membership, nationality, magic, motive or a recovered ship.
Optional Angelo asks why the Port Worker did not stop him. Camille is troubled and asks FI what they should do. The Port Worker says he never expected the man to sail away:because he was alone, he assumed he was inspecting or checking the ship. This explanatory line remains coherent without Angelo's optional challenge. Lil accepts that one would not expect him to set sail alone. Camille proposes gathering information in town and finding the ship thief. Optional Angelo invokes Mamma mia again and complains about their bad luck. Preserve the progression from disbelief and sleepy banter to confirmed loss, the food joke, witness report, explanation and practical search plan. Source explicit admiral addresses and one runtime FI remain intact. Mamma mia is a source-supported cultural expression; add no national biography. The exchange gives no specific port, exact time, duration, number of missing fleet ships, flagship designation, ownership document, recovered vessel or actual earned loss state. Preserve ship/boat reference consistently without inflating it into the whole fleet. records.whole_exchange_context:
B161 andB162 contain separate identical Port Worker utterances:it appears the ship has not returned yet. Keep the appearance/uncertainty andstill/not-yet sense. Their neighboring source B160 loss report andB163 return report support ship reference,not a fixed waiting time or known thief location. Do not collapse two source keys or infer their event conditions from their identical prose.
B163 is the complete return/confrontation/recruitment exchange. The Port Worker urgently tells the admiral the ship is back;Lil reacts,andoptional Angelo disbelieves with source Mamma mia. The worker points to the unmistakable ship. The newcomer shouts exuberantly about the vast sea andthe morning's fun,with repeated Yahoo-type cheers. Lil demands to know what he is doing with her ship;Camille orders him off. He insists he found it lying around. Camille rejects that absurd defense. Optional Angelo asks whether his brain has turned to strawberry jam,setting up the source name joke. The newcomer insists the ship looked lonely andabandoned in the harbor,so kindhearted Jam picked it up;he explicitly spells J-A-M andcheers. These are his self-serving assertions,not narrator confirmation that the ship was abandoned. Optional Angelo notices the Jam/brain-jam connection andtrails off;do not finish his thought into a new diagnosis.
Lil asks how merely finding a ship let him take it out to sea. His vague this-and-that/just-somehow answer andanother cheer contrast with her surprise that he did it alone. Camille tentatively calls him a possible genius. Lil asks what he would have done if unable to return. He tut-tuts,announces an aphorism about determination making things possible,cheers andapproves his own judgment. Optional Fernando mutters that someone troublesome has appeared. Lil scolds the repeated cheer. Jam boasts in exaggerated self-important language andproclaims a compressed intense-short-life motto,opposing it to a timid narrow long life. Preserve the deliberate contrast andhis odd verbal performance;do not turn it into an attributed philosophy,religion,national biography or new literal suicide/death plan. Optional Angelo wants to hand him to the guards. Camille instead asks FI to invite him. Optional Fernando sputters Camille's name;Lil objects;optional Angelo asks if Camille's brain has become strawberry jam too. Camille says the man is outrageous butamazing,able to set sail alone,andthe strangest person he has met,then pleads for agreement. Lil gives in,teasing that their navigators are all strange anyway. Optional Angelo protests that she looked at him when saying it;Camille's calming reply is in that same optional branch. Keep these speaker opinions andfamiliar jabs rather than narrator diagnoses.
Camille independently invites Jam to travel together. Jam makes a show of weighing the choice,uses an English-sounding Just a moment andasks for two seconds. The stated two seconds is spoken comedy,not proof of the source native pause operand's unit. He announces readiness;Camille asks if he has decided. Jam declares he will not go andwishes them a good trip. Lil's startled wait leads him to reveal that refusal was a joke,thank them with the source French Merci andcelebrate the reaction. Lil questions the joke. Jam then explicitly asks to be taken along andreintroduces his full name. The original catalogue spells actor11 Jam Jack Ludwyan;bind its current original native consumer andexisting naming policy before authoring,without guessing another full-name spelling. Preserve short Jam with the explicit J-A-M spelling andstrawberry-jam play. Mamma mia,Merci/Just a moment andhis repeated cheer are source-supported verbal choices;add no nationality or romance. Use approved Camille,Angelo andFernando,withone runtime FI. Lil and Camille are explicitly in Alexandria. Lil marvels at its size and the apparently endless African land. Camille is impressed by his claimed world travel and knowledge and invites him despite Lil's protests. Camille explicitly introduces Lil as their admiral. His suggestion that world travel implies sailing experience and useful shipboard skills remains his inference. Lil reluctantly but explicitly hires the newcomer, who gives his full name. Bind source actor13 to the existing native name before authoring; do not invent a profession, credential, military rank, nationality or relationship. The newcomer's repetitive formal de arimasu gives him a fussy, pedantic comic voice, contrasting with Lil's exasperated informality and Camille's curious, welcoming mediation.
Recruitment precedes the optional advice. The two choices concern hearing the new recruit's opinion about choosing ships, not accepting or refusing his employment. Declining elicits exaggerated praise of the admiral's independent principles, then his departure preparations. Listening elicits practical ship-purchasing advice, followed by the same preparations. Preserve both complete outcomes and the original choice and branch controls. Source0D is an actor selector requiring current original-consumer proof, not a carriage return to strip. This scoped proof cannot close the older-record0D technical audit.
The advice moves from contract towns and small market shares to increased purchasing power, affordable cargo capacity, medium ships, refitting and sailing distance, combat preparation and eventual regional fleets. Preserve every numerical threshold and comparison, the distinction between cargo and supply storage, sail-handling crew and marines, and qualified combat advice. Literal percentages must use percent in English. No extra currency, ship class, cargo unit, map rule or economic fact is supplied. Camille is impressed by his claimed world travel and knowledge and invites him despite Lil's protests. Camille explicitly introduces Lil as their admiral. His suggestion that world travel implies sailing experience and useful shipboard skills remains his inference. Lil reluctantly but explicitly hires the newcomer, who gives his full name. Bind source actor13 to the existing native name before authoring; do not invent a profession, credential, military rank, nationality or relationship. The newcomer's repetitive formal de arimasu gives him a fussy, pedantic comic voice, contrasting with Lil's exasperated informality and Camille's curious, welcoming mediation.
Recruitment precedes the optional advice. The two choices concern hearing the new recruit's opinion about choosing ships, not accepting or refusing his employment. Declining elicits exaggerated praise of the admiral's independent principles, then his departure preparations. Listening elicits practical ship-purchasing advice, followed by the same preparations. records.context:
An older sailor complains that nobody will give him a good drink and that going without one is especially hard for a man of the sea. The source does not specify wine, beer, a drinking contest, intoxication or addiction. Lil notices him muttering. The first Camille-presence branch has two alternatives: the solo R20 observation, or the R25-R33 exchange in which Lil calls Camille's attention to the complaining older man, Camille generalizes that everyone grows grumpy with age, and Lil insists she will remain the same, including her figure and mental sharpness. Do not combine both alternatives into one conversation. Without Camille, the source proceeds from the muttering observation directly to the older man's offended response; do not invent a missing explicit insult to make that path smoother.
The older man indignantly hears a claim that he is senile. In the Camille-present version this misconstrues Lil's boast about her own future. It remains his accusation, not an established diagnosis or narrator assessment. Optional Camille startles, apologizes and asks FI to apologize too. Lil refuses because the man misunderstood her on his own. He insists he did not mishear and is still an active navigator. Lil's patronizing discovery and wish for his long life provoke further anger; optional Camille reacts to FI's teasing. The man condemns the contrary girl and young people in general. Lil explicitly says she is an admiral and needles him as a formerly active navigator. The quotation marks on former/active carry deliberate contradiction, not proof of actual retirement. An older sailor complains that nobody will give him a good drink and that going without one is especially hard for a man of the sea. The source does not specify wine, beer, a drinking contest, intoxication or addiction. Lil notices him muttering. The first Camille-presence branch has two alternatives: the solo R20 observation, or the R25-R33 exchange in which Lil calls Camille's attention to the complaining older man, Camille generalizes that everyone grows grumpy with age, and Lil insists she will remain the same, including her figure and mental sharpness. Do not combine both alternatives into one conversation. Without Camille, the source proceeds from the muttering observation directly to the older man's offended response; do not invent a missing explicit insult to make that path smoother.
The older man indignantly hears a claim that he is senile. In the Camille-present version this misconstrues Lil's boast about her own future. It remains his accusation, not an established diagnosis or narrator assessment. Optional Camille startles, apologizes and asks FI to apologize too. Lil refuses because the man misunderstood her on his own. He insists he did not mishear and is still an active navigator. Lil's patronizing discovery and wish for his long life provoke further anger; optional Camille reacts to FI's teasing. The man condemns the contrary girl and young people in general. Lil explicitly says she is an admiral and needles him as a formerly active navigator. The quotation marks on former/active carry deliberate contradiction, not proof of actual retirement. Optional Camille says he cannot bear to watch the argument.
Hearing that she is an admiral, the man announces that he has decided to board her ship and personally educate her; he is not politely responding to an invitation. Lil protests the sudden conclusion. He orders her to show him the ship. Optional Camille privately wonders whether FI will become quieter, then openly advises giving in and taking the man along. Preserve the parenthesized thought as an aside rather than making it an audible insult. Lil reluctantly agrees. He tells her to heed a veteran, gives his full name and asks for a good working relationship. Bind actor6's existing native full-name spelling before authoring. Lil's yes-yes reply and demand that he prove he is active complete the earlier still-active/formerly-active joke.
Use an appropriate familiar older-man address without inventing kinship with Lil. No new grandfather relationship, formal rank, retired status, medical condition, named port, elapsed time or earned recruitment is supplied here. Source aging-related jabs and gruff pride remain character speech, not narrator facts. Keep distinct voices: Lil's sharp, irreverent teasing; Camille's anxious mediation; the older sailor's gruff wounded pride, imperatives and veteran authority. There are five original Camille membership sites, twenty relative spans, three FI substitutions, one later A000, source45FF/4631/4620/6005 andresource6329, withone declared end.
